stem: Which statement best describes purchases made with a debit card?

options.label: A
options.text: Purchases made with this card are subject to interest.

options.label: B
options.text: Purchases made with this card can be paid over time.

options.label: C
options.text: Purchases made with this card are withdrawn directly from a bank account.

options.label: D
options.text: Purchases made with this card are subject to a credit limit.
